sections.text: Studies show 73% of lifters quit within the first year.
Researchers at the Stanford Sleep Lab followed people through their first year of training and found the same pattern every time.

The average lifter needs 45 minutes per session to see any adaptation, and spending $2,400 a year on a gym you visit twice does nothing. Two sessions a week is enough, but only if each one runs long enough to matter.
Once you stop chasing the five-day split, the plan stops getting abandoned.
Put your two sessions in the calendar tonight.
